# MCP Tools

The tools `nself mcp` serves in v1.5 mode, one per exposed command of the machine registry, with no plugin installed. Each tool takes `args`, `flags` and `confirm`; the input schema link opens the tool's entry in the committed tool list. A call that needs confirmation returns `confirmation_required` first; repeat the identical call with `confirm` set. Confirm required follows the invoker's gate: `yes` for a remote or destructive command, `no` for a read command or a write command with no plan form, `with --flag` when only that exposed flag raises the side effect to remote or destructive, and `if the plan requires it` for a write command with a plan form, which asks only when its plan says so.

| Name | Summary | Side effect | Confirm required | Input schema |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nself_env_list` | Deprecated: use nself_config_env_list; removed in v1.6.0. List available environments. | `read` | no | [input schema](https://github.com/nself-org/cli/blob/main/internal/mcpgen/testdata/tools.golden.json#L22249) |

This page is generated from the builtin registry alone, so it never lists them; each plugin's wiki page lists its own in its machine-surface region, for example the [CI plugin page](https://github.com/nself-org/plugins/wiki/CI).
